name: Event / Launch
description: A one-page event, conference, launch, or webinar page: hero with the event name, date and location, a register CTA, a facts band (date / venue / format / price), a time-ordered agenda/schedule, a speakers grid, and a closing RSVP call-to-action. Use for 'make a page for our launch event / conference / meetup / webinar'.

event_name.description: Event name shown in the header and hero

accent.description: Hex accent color driving CTAs, highlights, and the glow. Match the event's brand.

nav.description: Header anchor links (2-4). Omit for a bare header.

kicker.description: Small label above the hero title (e.g. 'Annual Conference · 3rd edition'). Optional.

headline.description: Hero headline / event tagline — the reason to attend.
headline.default: Two days on the edge of what's possible.

location_label.description: Venue / city, or 'Online' for a virtual event.

subhead.description: One or two sentences on who it's for and what they'll get.
subhead.default: A focused, high-signal event for the people building what's next — talks, workshops, and the hallway conversations that actually move things forward.

secondary_cta.description: Optional secondary button (e.g. view schedule). Omit to show only the primary.

facts.description: Key facts band (2-4): date, venue, format, price, etc. Each is a label + a value.

highlights_title.description: Heading for the 'what to expect' highlights section.

highlights_subhead.description: Optional subtext under the highlights heading.
highlights_subhead.default: Two days built around learning, building, and meeting the people behind the work.

highlights.description: Highlight cards (3 read best). Each has a short icon (emoji works), a title, and a one-line body. Set to null to hide the section.

default.title: Talks that matter
default.body: Keynotes and deep-dives from people shipping at the frontier — no filler.

default.title: Hands-on workshops
default.body: Small-group sessions where you build something real and leave with it.

default.title: Real connections
default.body: Curated hallway time and a closing social — the part you'll remember.

agenda.description: Time-ordered agenda rows. Each has a time, a session title, an optional one-line description, and an optional speaker name.

default.title: Doors & coffee
default.desc: Registration opens; grab a badge and a flat white.

default.title: Opening keynote
default.desc: Where the field is heading and why it matters now.
default.speaker: Dr. Mara Quinn

default.title: Hands-on workshop
default.desc: Build a working prototype start to finish.
default.speaker: Sam Okafor

default.title: Lightning talks
default.desc: Six speakers, six ideas, six minutes each.

default.title: Closing panel & social
default.desc: Open Q&A, then drinks on the terrace.

speakers_title.description: Heading for the speakers section. Omit the whole section by setting speakers to null.

speakers.description: Speaker cards. Each has a name, a role/affiliation, and 1-2 initials used for the avatar circle (no photos).

sponsors_label.description: Caption above the sponsors strip. Optional.

sponsors.description: Sponsor names rendered as text logos (no images). Set to null to hide the strip.

closing_headline.description: Heading for the final register section.

closing_subhead.description: Subtext under the closing headline. Optional.
closing_subhead.default: Limited capacity. Early-bird pricing ends soon.
